title: MyLinden Signed Action Reference: Moving an Imaging or Procedure Authorization to Another Site
content:
When an approved imaging or procedure prior authorization — an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization under Referrals & Prior Authorizations — is moved to another site, the patient signs for a pre-service estimate of the amount asked of them at check-in for the study at that site, and the site change is recorded together with that estimate. The site given is the clinic location of the study booked against the authorization, copied exactly.

## What the signed action does

One signed action changes the site named on the authorization to the site given and files the patient's signed provider-change request on the authorization, carrying the estimated amount the patient accepted. The request is recorded as signed by the patient at the moment of the action. The units and the validity dates of the authorization are left exactly as they are. Afterwards the authorization shows the new site, and the authorization's request list shows one provider-change request with status `patient_signed`.

## How it is invoked

The action is `confirm_imaging_site_change_a21d40f9`. It is a patient's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the patient — runs it and signs.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_id` | the reference number of the prior authorization being moved, as shown on the authorization returned by the referral lookup for this patient | identifier, as shown |
| `new_rendering_site` | the site the study is moved to, copied exactly as the clinic location appears on the patient's booked study | verbatim text, character for character, preserving wording, digits and punctuation, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion |
| `estimated_patient_share_usd` | the pre-service estimate of the patient's own payment for the study at the new site that the patient signs for | US dollars, a non-negative number with exactly 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, no currency sign |

## Return

A successful action returns:

- `request_id` — the reference of the signed provider-change request;
- `referral_id` — the authorization moved;
- `rendering_provider` — the site now named on the authorization;
- `estimated_patient_share_usd` — the estimate signed for, to 2 decimal places;
- `request_status` — always `patient_signed`, which indicates the change is recorded.

A returned `request_id` means success.

## Illustration of the call shape (hypothetical values)

An authorization with reference RF-EXAMPLE moved to a booked study whose clinic location reads "Linden Ridge Imaging — Example Campus, Suite 2" is passed with `new_rendering_site` set to exactly that text, and with `estimated_patient_share_usd` written as a figure such as 0.00 or 125.40 — never as "$125.4".
